reason: After the patch removed the only cacheHit:true case, TestService_getUserPermissions has only cacheHit:false cases (pkg/services/authz/rbac/service_test.go:341-356), so the field at :337 and the branches at :367 and :388 are dead; no test covers the anonymous cache path either. The coverage half is overstated for users: "Fallback to the database on outdated cache" in TestService_CacheCheck (added by the patch) does indirectly assert that the store is consulted despite a populated cache.
